Whether you’re in the mood to feel a little extra glow from Fuzz, peek into a playful fortune with Madame Oodlepoof, or take a snack break to learn something zany (but true!) with Ziggy, this bundle has you covered.

seo.description: Yoto Says: Take your pick from 3 unique cards packed with affirmations, quirky fortunes, and totally random facts! Say hello to a totally terrific trio of delightful new companions - Fuzz, Madame Oodlepoof, and Ziggy! This collection brings together heartwarming affirmations, silly fortunes and brain-boosting facts, through the magic of your Yoto player.Whether you’re in the mood to feel a little extra glow from Fuzz, peek into a playful fortune with Madame Oodlepoof, or take a snack break to learn something zany (but true!) with Ziggy, this bundle has you covered. With over 300 responses across three cards, there’s always something fun and totally random to discover!PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto player or Yoto Mini to experience the interactive randomisation of the responses as designed. Tracks included: Intro, 2_Music_Sting_Short_Brain_Snacks_Atom_GIF.wav, 1_Brain_Snacks_Response.wav, 7_Brain_Snacks_Outro.wav, 3_Music_Sting_Short_Brain_Snacks_Hourglass_GIF.wav and more.

seo.description: Yoto Says: Take your pick from 3 unique cards packed with affirmations, quirky fortunes, and totally random facts! Say hello to a totally terrific trio of delightful new companions - Fuzz, Madame Oodlepoof, and Ziggy! This collection brings together heartwarming affirmations, silly fortunes and brain-boosting facts, through the magic of your Yoto player.Whether you’re in the mood to feel a little extra glow from Fuzz, peek into a playful fortune with Madame Oodlepoof, or take a snack break to learn something zany (but true!) with Ziggy, this bundle has you covered. With over 300 responses across three cards, there’s always something fun and totally random to discover!PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto player or Yoto Mini to experience the interactive randomisation of the responses as designed. Tracks included: Intro, 2_Music_Sting_Short_Brain_Snacks_Atom_GIF.wav, 1_Brain_Snacks_Response.wav, 7_Brain_Snacks_Outro.wav, 3_Music_Sting_Short_Brain_Snacks_Hourglass_GIF.wav and more.
